parts.text: My Jewish friends who keep kosher are staying with us during Passover. What should I cook for them for dinner tonight?

Two sets of rules apply at once. Their everyday rules come from keeping kosher: no pork or shellfish, and no meat and dairy in the same meal. Passover adds a stricter layer on top: no chametz, so nothing leavened or made from ordinary wheat flour, such as bread, pasta or most baked goods. A dinner that satisfies both layers: roast chicken from a kosher-for-Passover butcher, roasted vegetables, matzo, and a dairy-free fruit dessert.
